AgentSession: run coordination
|
|-- prompt() / _preparePrompt()
|   |-- Extension command may handle input without an LLM run
|   |-- -> input hooks; skill/template expansion
|   |-- Streaming: require streamingBehavior -> steer/followUp; otherwise throw
|   `-- Idle: validate model/auth -> _startRun()
|-- _startRun() / _prepareRun()
|   |-- Check compaction -> before_agent_start -> normalize images
|   |-- Prompt options + tool loadout -> messages and system patch
|   `-- -> Agent.prompt(messages)
|-- Held Agent
|   |-- Live state, message queues and activeRun controller
|   `-- prompt()/continue() -> runAgentLoop()/runAgentLoopContinue()
|       |-- prepareRequest -> canonical history projection and model routing
|       |-- streamAssistantResponse -> transformContext -> convertToLlm -> streamFn
|       |-- Assistant tool calls -> executeToolCalls -> tool-result messages
|       |-- Tool results / steering -> another assistant turn
|       |-- Follow-ups drain when the loop would otherwise stop
|       `-- -> Agent events -> AgentSession._handleAgentEvent()
|-- _handlePostAgentRun() + before-settle boundary
|   |-- Retryable errors / overflow recovery -> Agent.continue()
|   |-- Boundary continuation and late queues can restart the low-level loop
|   `-- Finally -> agent_settled, not merely agent_end
|-- compact() / automatic compaction
|   |-- Branch + model limits/settings -> prepareCompaction()
|   |-- -> extension cancellation/summary, or default summary generation
|   `-- -> appendCompaction() -> refresh finalized Agent context
`-- abort(): cancel agent/recovery work -> await waitForIdle()
    `-- Bash has separate abortBash(); dispose() invokes it
